sentence: This project builds a way to guide stem cells to become human liver cells and to improve how liver organoids are made.
This project studies how to reduce the environmental impacts of computing, steel and electricity, and transportation.
This project builds computer methods that let robots learn reliable dexterous manipulation skills without vast amounts of data or computing resources.
This project uses population genetics to study how maize and humans changed together during domestication.
This project tries to find genes that may help explain why wood warblers split into so many species.
This project uses machine learning to choose the right solver for finding collision-free paths for many robots in a shared space.
This project builds devices that use Floquet-engineered quantum states to detect and image single photons.
This project tests a computer model of how insect camera-type eyes develop by studying two insect species.
This project studies how repeated quantum measurements change the growth and spread of quantum entanglement in bosonic systems.
This project tries to make atomically thin MXene materials with clean surfaces and to measure their intrinsic properties.
This project builds a soft feeding device that can gently handle foods of different shapes and textures.
This project studies the chemical and bacterial changes that happen in corals during stony coral tissue loss disease.
This project builds a system that permanently records how microscopes were set up, so other scientists can trust and reuse the data.
This project improves storage for herbarium specimens and puts images and data about them online where anyone can search them.
This project studies how to defend deep learning navigation systems for unmanned aerial vehicles against attacks that make small changes to sensed data.
